question: How big must an odd perfect number be, if one exists?
answer: The card says that if an odd perfect number exists, it must have more than 2,200 digits, so it exceeds 10^2,200. No computer can check numbers that large one by one, so only a clever proof can settle the question.
move: An odd perfect number, if real, exceeds 10 2,200 .
